tools.name: Remotion
tools.token_integration: Consumes shared DesignTokens and Basalt CSS variables in compositions.
tools.platform_rationale: Remotion is a React/DOM programmatic video composition framework running in headless Chromium (`RemotionComposition`), belonging strictly to the frozen web/video backlog.

tools.name: @remotion/transitions
tools.token_integration: Maps transition timing to shared DesignTokens and StrataMotion easings.
tools.platform_rationale: @remotion/transitions is a Remotion sub-package for scene transitions in React video compositions; strictly `web` backlog.

tools.name: Motion
tools.token_integration: Uses StrataMotion or Basalt token-backed spring and layout values.
tools.platform_rationale: Motion (Framer Motion) is a React/DOM animation library; on Apple platforms it is replaced by native SwiftUI springs, `PhaseAnimator`, and `KeyframeAnimator`.

tools.name: Anime.js
tools.token_integration: Maps authored timelines, stagger, and SVG colors to tokens.
tools.platform_rationale: Anime.js is a JavaScript DOM/SVG timeline library; on macOS/iOS it is superseded by native SwiftUI `KeyframeAnimator`, `TimelineView`, and `Canvas`.

tools.name: Lottie
tools.token_integration: Exports token-colored illustrations for web and lottie-ios/SwiftUI.
tools.platform_rationale: Lottie vector animations run natively on macOS (`desktop`) and iOS/iPadOS (`mobile`) via `lottie-spm` (`LottieView` in SwiftUI) alongside native SF Symbols `.symbolEffect`, as well as on `web`.

tools.name: Three.js
tools.token_integration: Binds scene materials and camera presets to DesignTokens/Basalt.
tools.platform_rationale: Three.js is a browser WebGL/WebGPU 3D library; native Apple 3D surfaces use RealityKit, SceneKit, or Metal instead.

tools.name: Postprocessing
tools.token_integration: Tokenizes bloom, depth-of-field, and aberration strengths.
tools.platform_rationale: Postprocessing is a Three.js WebGL shader pass library; on Apple platforms post-processing uses native SwiftUI `.layerEffect`/`.colorEffect` (`ShaderLibrary`) or Metal.

tools.name: Three.quarks
tools.token_integration: Uses token-backed particle colors, rates, and sizes.
tools.platform_rationale: Three.quarks is a Three.js WebGL particle system; on Apple platforms particles are built with SwiftUI `TimelineView` + `Canvas`, `CAEmitterLayer`, or RealityKit.

tools.name: Jolt Physics
tools.token_integration: Serializes stable simulation constants beside motion tokens.
tools.platform_rationale: Jolt Physics in this catalog is wired for WebAssembly/Three.js scenes; native Apple physics use SpriteKit/RealityKit or SwiftUI spring dynamics.

tools.name: GPU Pathtracer
tools.token_integration: Keeps render quality, lighting, and material presets in the token contract.
tools.platform_rationale: GPU Pathtracer is a Three.js WebGL path-tracing renderer for browser/offline video scenes; strictly `web-video-backlog`.

tools.name: MCP for Blender
tools.token_integration: Exports GLTF for web and USDZ/OBJ for RealityKit/SceneKit using shared materials.
tools.platform_rationale: MCP for Blender automates 3D asset authoring and exports USDZ/OBJ models directly consumable by native macOS (`desktop`) and iOS (`mobile`) RealityKit/`Model3D`/SceneKit views, plus GLTF for `web`.

tools.name: Tweakpane
tools.token_integration: Tunes values in development, then serializes final constants to Basalt.
tools.platform_rationale: Tweakpane is a browser DOM parameter-tuning overlay; native Apple development uses SwiftUI `#Preview` inspectors and native debug sheets.

tools.name: Manim
tools.token_integration: Matches typography, color, and spacing to the shared design contract.
tools.platform_rationale: Manim is an offline Python mathematical animation engine for video production (`Video/Offline`), grouped under the frozen web/video backlog.

tools.name: CosyVoice
tools.token_integration: Voiceover scripts and captions use product language tokens.
tools.platform_rationale: CosyVoice is an offline TTS voiceover generator for programmatic video pipelines (`Video/Offline`), placed in `web-video-backlog`.

tools.name: WhisperX
tools.token_integration: Word timestamps drive tokenized, frame-aligned caption components.
tools.platform_rationale: WhisperX generates word-level timestamps for offline Remotion video captions (`Video/Offline`), placed in `web-video-backlog`.

tools.name: Librosa
tools.token_integration: Emits normalized beat cues consumed by tokenized transitions.
tools.platform_rationale: Librosa extracts audio beat cues for offline video transition synchronization (`Video/Offline`), placed in `web-video-backlog`.

tools.name: @ffmpeg/ffmpeg
tools.token_integration: Encodes from shared size, color, and caption presets.
tools.platform_rationale: @ffmpeg/ffmpeg is the WebAssembly browser build of FFmpeg for web/video encoding; strictly `web-video-backlog`.

tools.name: FFmpeg CLI
tools.token_integration: Provides reproducible render, loudness normalization, and slicing boundaries.
tools.platform_rationale: FFmpeg CLI is used in the offline video rendering and normalization pipeline (`Video/Offline`); classified under `web-video-backlog`.

tools.name: OBS Studio
tools.token_integration: Captures reference footage using approved palette and dimensions.
tools.platform_rationale: OBS Studio is a manual screen-capture tool for offline video production workflows (`Video/Offline`); classified under `web-video-backlog`.

tools.name: LosslessCut
tools.token_integration: Keeps rough cuts aligned with the Remotion/FFmpeg export contract.
tools.platform_rationale: LosslessCut is a manual video trimming utility for offline Remotion/FFmpeg exports (`Video/Offline`); classified under `web-video-backlog`.

inspirations.name: 卡片揭角 (Card Corner Peel)
inspirations.source_prompt_zh: 做一张可揭角的卡片，右下角按住后随拖动卷起，用折线裁切正面并露出背面，折片带柔和明暗。松手沿原路回落，短距离拖动只露一角，整张卡片保持稳定。
inspirations.canonical_prompt: Drag the card's lower-right corner to peel a clipped front layer, reveal the back, then spring back along the inverse path unless committed.
inspirations.state_machine: idle -> press -> drag -> partial_peel -> release -> spring_settle
inspirations.web_implementation: Motion drag progress with CSS clip-path polygon and @nocoo/basalt tokens.
inspirations.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI DragGesture with Canvas/path clipping, StrataMotion spring, and Reduce Motion crossfade.
inspirations.token_guardrails: CLS = 0; tabular-nums where values appear; >=4.5:1 contrast; 44x44pt hit target; Reduce Motion fallback.
inspirations.desktop_macos_implementation: SwiftUI `.onContinuousHover` for corner curl preview plus pointer `DragGesture` driving a custom `Shape` or `Canvas` clip path and `.visualEffect` / Metal `ShaderLibrary` crease shading; settles with native `Animation.spring(duration: 0.38, bounce: 0.15)` while keeping the outer card frame locked inside its `NSWindow` or `NSPopover` grid.
inspirations.mobile_ios_implementation: SwiftUI `DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0)` on a 44x44pt lower-right corner hit region, clipping the front card layer via a dynamic `Path`/`Canvas` fold line and revealing the back layer; uses `Animation.spring(response: 0.35, dampingFraction: 0.78)` on release and `.sensoryFeedback(.impact(flexibility: .soft), trigger: isCommitted)`.
inspirations.native_guardrails: Zero layout shift (card bounds never jump); `.monospacedDigit()` on any revealed numeric metrics; >=4.5:1 foreground/background contrast in Light and Dark mode using semantic `Color.primary` / `Color(nsColor: .controlBackgroundColor)` / `Color(uiColor: .secondarySystemGroupedBackground)`; >=44x44pt corner hit target on iOS and >=28x28pt on macOS; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` replaces peel geometry with a direct `.opacity` crossfade; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceTransparency)` replaces translucent back-card layers with opaque system surfaces.

inspirations.name: 滑动确认 (Slide-to-Confirm)
inspirations.source_prompt_zh: 做一个滑动确认按钮，圆钮与轨道填充跟随同一拖动进度。未到终点松手，阻尼回到起点且不执行；到终点松手才确认，箭头变成对勾，文字变为已完成。
inspirations.canonical_prompt: Keep thumb and track fill on one normalized drag progress; cancel below the endpoint with damped return, commit only at endpoint, then swap arrow to checkmark and copy.
inspirations.web_implementation: Motion drag controls thumb and track; CSS/SVG icon morph; Basalt semantic success tokens.
inspirations.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI DragGesture with StrataMotion spring, contentTransition(.symbolEffect), SensoryFeedback, and numericText.
inspirations.token_guardrails: No accidental commit; 44x44pt target; explicit threshold; >=4.5:1 contrast; Reduce Motion opacity/state fallback.
inspirations.desktop_macos_implementation: SwiftUI pointer `DragGesture` (plus keyboard `Return` / `⌘Return` confirmation equivalent) binding a single normalized progress `CGFloat` (`0.0...1.0`) to both the thumb offset and track fill width; commits only when released at `progress >= 0.95`, morphing SF Symbols (`arrow.right` to `checkmark`) via `.contentTransition(.symbolEffect(.replace))` and settling with `Animation.spring(duration: 0.3, bounce: 0.1)`.
inspirations.mobile_ios_implementation: SwiftUI `DragGesture` on a 44x44pt thumb inside a capsule track (`GlassEffectContainer` / `.glassEffect(.regular.interactive(), in: .capsule)` where appropriate), driving thumb position and tint fill from one shared progress state; damped return via `Animation.spring(response: 0.32, dampingFraction: 0.82)` if released early, or commit at endpoint with `.contentTransition(.symbolEffect(.replace))`, `.contentTransition(.numericText())`, and `.sensoryFeedback(.success, trigger: isConfirmed)`.
inspirations.native_guardrails: No accidental commit below threshold; >=44x44pt thumb hit target on iOS and >=32x32pt on macOS with full keyboard accessibility (`accessibilityAction`); >=4.5:1 text and icon contrast against both unfilled and filled semantic `Color.green` / `Color.accentColor` tracks in Light and Dark modes; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` disables spring oscillation and uses instant state/opacity transition; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceTransparency)` backs the track with solid `Color(uiColor: .tertiarySystemFill)`.

inspirations.name: 拉绳开关 (Pull-Cord Light Switch)
inspirations.source_prompt_zh: 做一个拉绳灯光开关，绳头跟随竖向拖动，超过触发距离时切换灯光与玻璃暖光，每次拉动切换一次。松手收回绳子，摆幅逐渐衰减，再拉一次可以关闭。
inspirations.canonical_prompt: Track vertical cord drag; cross the trigger distance once to toggle light and warm glass glow, then return with damped swing and allow the next pull to turn it off.
inspirations.state_machine: off_idle -> pull -> threshold -> on_commit -> return_swing -> on_idle -> pull -> off_commit -> settle
inspirations.web_implementation: Motion drag transform with Anime.js damped return and tokenized warm-glow CSS.
inspirations.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI DragGesture plus KeyframeAnimator/StrataMotion, ShaderLibrary glow, and SensoryFeedback.
inspirations.token_guardrails: One toggle per pull; bounded drag; no glare-only status; 44x44pt target; Reduce Motion removes swing.
inspirations.desktop_macos_implementation: SwiftUI vertical pointer `DragGesture` on the cord handle with direct click/keyboard (`Space`) toggle support; crossing the vertical threshold toggles state once per pull, drives warm illumination via native `Canvas` / `.shadow` / `NSGlassEffectView` tinting, and animates the cord's damped pendulum return using `KeyframeAnimator` with `SpringKeyframe`.
inspirations.mobile_ios_implementation: SwiftUI vertical `DragGesture` on a >=44x44pt cord handle target; crossing the trigger distance fires `.sensoryFeedback(.impact(weight: .medium), trigger: isLit)`, toggles the ambient glass glow (`.glassEffect` / radial gradient overlay), and settles the cord back with `KeyframeAnimator` damped swing.
inspirations.native_guardrails: Strictly one toggle per pull cycle with bounded vertical drag distance; state is never communicated by glow alone (always pair with explicit SF Symbol `lightbulb.fill` / `lightbulb` and semantic label); >=44x44pt hit target on iOS and >=28x28pt on macOS; >=4.5:1 contrast in Light and Dark appearances; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` eliminates pendulum swing and snaps the cord smoothly; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceTransparency)` uses opaque warm surface fills.

inspirations.name: 滑动工具栏 (Magnification Scrubbing Toolbar)
inspirations.source_prompt_zh: 做一条可滑选的工具栏，当前图标随手指靠近连续放大，相邻图标平滑让位，位置由实时宽度累加计算。显示当前名称，松手提交选择，画布同步切换工具效果。
inspirations.canonical_prompt: Scrub across a toolbar whose focused icon magnifies continuously and neighbors make room from live accumulated widths; show the name and commit the selected tool on release.
inspirations.state_machine: idle -> hover/drag -> focus_magnify -> neighbor_reflow -> release -> commit -> settle
inspirations.web_implementation: Motion layout animation with measured widths, CSS transform scale, and tokenized focus ring.
inspirations.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI DragGesture with matchedGeometryEffect, measured layout, and StrataMotion spring.
inspirations.token_guardrails: Live width accumulation, no overlap, single-line label, 44x44pt targets, Reduce Motion uses discrete focus.
inspirations.desktop_macos_implementation: Mac Dock-style scrubbing bar using SwiftUI `.onContinuousHover` and pointer `DragGesture` inside a `GeometryReader` / custom `Layout` that computes each icon's scale from pointer distance and accumulates live widths so neighbors reflow without overlap; displays a single-line tooltip label and commits on click/release with `Animation.interactiveSpring(response: 0.25, dampingFraction: 0.8)`.
inspirations.mobile_ios_implementation: Touch-scrubbing floating toolbar inside a `GlassEffectContainer` using `.glassEffect(.regular.interactive(), in: .capsule)` and `DragGesture(minimumDistance: 0)` to track finger X location, continuously scaling the focused SF Symbol icon while reflowing neighbors from live accumulated widths; emits `.sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: hoveredToolID)` as focus changes and commits the active tool on finger release.
inspirations.native_guardrails: Positions derived from live width accumulation so icons never overlap or clip; single-line non-wrapping tool label; >=44x44pt effective touch targets on iOS and >=28x28pt pointer targets on macOS with keyboard arrow-key navigation; >=4.5:1 contrast in Light and Dark modes; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` replaces continuous magnification with discrete highlight focus; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceTransparency)` replaces Liquid Glass bar material with opaque system background.

inspirations.name: 消息气泡反馈 (Long-Press Bubble Reaction)
inspirations.source_prompt_zh: 长按消息后拾起当前气泡，周围消息降低亮度，三枚表情错峰展开。选中并松手后，同一表情沿弧线缩到气泡角标，菜单收回。徽标随气泡归位，再点可取消。
inspirations.canonical_prompt: Long-press and lift the message bubble, dim neighbors, stagger three reactions, then arc the selected reaction into the bubble badge on release; tap again cancels.
inspirations.state_machine: idle -> long_press -> lifted_dimmed -> reaction_menu -> select -> arc_commit/cancel -> settle
inspirations.web_implementation: Motion shared layout with Anime.js stagger and SVG arc path; Basalt reaction tokens.
inspirations.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI long press, matchedGeometryEffect, KeyframeAnimator arc, and SensoryFeedback.
inspirations.token_guardrails: Preserve message context; 44x44pt reactions; tabular-nums for counts; Reduce Motion uses fade/scale.
inspirations.desktop_macos_implementation: Hover action bar or secondary-click / long-press on a message bubble that dims surrounding rows via `.opacity`, presents staggered SF Symbol / emoji reaction items in a floating `.glassEffect` or `NSPopover`-style callout using `PhaseAnimator`, and arcs the chosen reaction into the bubble corner badge via `matchedGeometryEffect` and `KeyframeAnimator` (clicking the badge again removes it).
inspirations.mobile_ios_implementation: SwiftUI `LongPressGesture` sequenced with `DragGesture` that lifts the target message bubble with `.scaleEffect`, dims background context, staggers three reaction pills inside a `GlassEffectContainer` (`.glassEffectID` morphing), fires `.sensoryFeedback(.impact(weight: .light), trigger: isMenuOpen)`, and animates the selected reaction along a `KeyframeAnimator` arc into the corner badge on release.
inspirations.native_guardrails: Message list scroll offset and layout stability preserved (`CLS = 0`); `.monospacedDigit()` on reaction count badges; >=44x44pt hit targets for each reaction option on iOS and >=28x28pt on macOS; >=4.5:1 badge contrast in Light and Dark modes; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` replaces staggered lift and arc trajectory with a direct scale/opacity transition; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceTransparency)` uses opaque elevated surface colors for the reaction bar and badge.

inspirations.name: 文件拖入文件夹 (Spring-Loaded Folder Drop)
inspirations.source_prompt_zh: 拖动文件靠近文件夹时，夹口张开并显示落点；悬停阶段保持原数量；松手命中后文件缩进前后盖之间，数量加一，再合上夹口；未命中则回到原位置。
inspirations.canonical_prompt: When a dragged file nears a folder, open the folder and show the drop target without changing count; on hit, tuck the file between covers, increment count, and close, otherwise return.
inspirations.state_machine: idle -> drag -> near_target -> folder_open -> hover -> commit/cancel -> settle
inspirations.web_implementation: Motion pointer drag with Anime.js folder lid choreography, hit testing, and numeric transition.
inspirations.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI DragGesture/drop delegate, matchedGeometryEffect tuck, numericText count, and SensoryFeedback.
inspirations.token_guardrails: Visible target and hit parity; count changes only on commit; 44x44pt targets; Reduce Motion crossfade.
inspirations.desktop_macos_implementation: SwiftUI `.draggable` / `.dropDestination` (or spatial `DragGesture` with `DropDelegate`) on macOS where hovering near a folder opens the front/back folder layers using `Animation.spring(duration: 0.28)` and highlights the drop ring without mutating the item count; releasing inside the target tucks the item between folder covers via `matchedGeometryEffect`, increments the `.monospacedDigit()` badge with `.contentTransition(.numericText())`, and closes the folder.
inspirations.mobile_ios_implementation: SwiftUI `DragGesture` / `.dropDestination` with proximity detection that opens the folder icon layers and triggers `.sensoryFeedback(.alignment, trigger: isHoveringFolder)`; dropping on target tucks the file card into the folder via `matchedGeometryEffect`, updates the count badge with `.contentTransition(.numericText())` and `.sensoryFeedback(.success, trigger: dropCommitted)`, or springs back to origin if cancelled.
inspirations.native_guardrails: Visual drop target boundary matches hit-test geometry 1:1; folder item count mutates strictly on commit (never during hover); `.monospacedDigit()` on count readouts; >=44x44pt drop target on iOS and >=28x28pt on macOS; >=4.5:1 contrast in Light and Dark modes; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` replaces folder-lid 3D/spring choreography with a highlight border and crossfade.

inspirations.name: 图表联动筛选 (Chart Cross-Filtering)
inspirations.source_prompt_zh: 点图表里的分类，下方列表和统计数字跟着变，再点一下全部恢复。
inspirations.canonical_prompt: Click a chart category/segment to highlight it and cross-filter the list and summary metrics below; click the same category again to reset to all items.
inspirations.web_implementation: Derive list and KPIs from a shared activeCategory state; highlight active Recharts/Basalt segment, dim unselected segments, and toggle off on repeat click.
inspirations.mobile_implementation: SwiftUI Charts selection binding filtering the shared query state with .contentTransition(.numericText()) on summary readouts and tap-to-deselect.
inspirations.token_guardrails: tabular-nums / monospacedDigit for changing metrics; preserve active search keyword and sort order; >=4.5:1 active/inactive contrast.
inspirations.desktop_macos_implementation: Swift Charts `Chart` with `.chartAngleSelection(value:)` or `.chartXSelection(value:)` (plus direct pointer click/hover on marks) bound to an `@Observable` view model's `selectedCategory` property; selecting a mark highlights the active series, dims unselected marks via `.opacity(0.3)`, and synchronously filters the macOS `Table` / `List` and summary KPI cards (`.contentTransition(.numericText())`); clicking the same category or pressing `Esc` resets to all items.
inspirations.mobile_ios_implementation: Swift Charts interactive selection binding (`.chartXSelection` / `.chartAngleSelection`) on a touch-friendly chart mark (>=44x44pt effective selection zone) with `.sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: selectedCategory)`; updates the shared `@Observable` filter state to cross-filter the `List` / `LazyVStack` and animate summary metrics via `.contentTransition(.numericText())` with tap-again-to-reset.
inspirations.native_guardrails: All changing KPI numbers use `.monospacedDigit()` so layout never shifts; cross-filtering preserves any active search text and sort descriptor; active vs. dimmed chart marks and text maintain >=4.5:1 contrast in Light and Dark modes using distinct Swift Charts foreground style scales separate from semantic status colors; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` disables animated chart bar/sector morphing.

inspirations.name: 组合筛选与排序 (Combined Filter & Orthogonal Sort)
inspirations.source_prompt_zh: 选好类别搜关键词，还能按数量升降序排，而且排序不会清空之前的筛选条件。
inspirations.canonical_prompt: Compose category filter, keyword search, and ascending/descending sort orthogonally; toggling sort order reorders the filtered subset without clearing active filters.
inspirations.web_implementation: Pure derived selector: filter(items, category, keyword) then sort(field, dir); keep filter and sort controls in independent state slices.
inspirations.mobile_implementation: SwiftUIsearchable + category filter tokens + Menu/Picker sort descriptor operating on the filtered collection without resetting filter state.
inspirations.token_guardrails: Sorting never clears filter/search state; provide clear active indicators and reset options.
inspirations.desktop_macos_implementation: SwiftUI `.searchable` field in the window/split-view toolbar, horizontal category filter tokens/segmented `Picker`, and `Table` column `SortComparator` (or toolbar sort `Menu`) backed by independent properties on an `@Observable` state model; a pure derived computed array applies category + keyword filtering first and sorts the resulting slice without ever clearing active filter state.
inspirations.mobile_ios_implementation: Navigation-integrated `.searchable` bar, horizontal scrolling category filter capsules (`>=44pt` touch height), and a trailing toolbar `Menu` / `Picker` for ascending/descending `SortDescriptor` operating orthogonally on the filtered collection with `.sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: sortOrder)` and animated list reordering.
inspirations.native_guardrails: Changing sort field or direction never resets active search text or category filters; active filter count and sort direction remain visibly indicated with >=4.5:1 contrast in Light and Dark modes; hit targets >=44x44pt on iOS and >=28x28pt on macOS; `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` disables row reordering animations.

inspirations.name: 列表联动详情 (In-Place Master-Detail Linkage)
inspirations.source_prompt_zh: 点左侧记录，右侧详情直接更新，不用跳页面，列表顺序也不变。
inspirations.canonical_prompt: Select a record in the master list to update the detail pane in-place without page navigation, preserving the master list's sort order, filters, and scroll position.
inspirations.web_implementation: Two-column master-detail layout with selectedId state; render detail panel in-place and keep master list key/scroll stable.
inspirations.mobile_implementation: NavigationSplitView on iPad/macOS or in-place detail card/sheet on compact screens, preserving list scroll and ordering.
inspirations.token_guardrails: CLS = 0 on selection; master list order and scroll offset remain unchanged; clear selected row state.
inspirations.desktop_macos_implementation: Two- or three-column `NavigationSplitView` (or trailing `.inspector(isPresented:)`) where `List(selection: $selectedItemID)` updates the detail pane in-place on pointer click or up/down arrow keys without mutating the master list's sort order, active filters, or `ScrollView` offset.
inspirations.mobile_ios_implementation: Adaptive `NavigationSplitView` on regular horizontal size class (`horizontalSizeClass == .regular` on iPad / landscape) and in-place detail card or `.sheet(item: $selectedItem)` / `NavigationStack` on compact iPhone screens, preserving the master `List` scroll position, filter state, and row ordering across selection changes.
inspirations.native_guardrails: Zero layout jump (`CLS = 0`) and preserved scroll offset in the master list when selecting or switching records; selected row uses native system selection highlight with >=4.5:1 text contrast in Light and Dark modes; >=44pt minimum row height on iOS and >=28pt on macOS; respects `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` and `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceTransparency)`.

inspirations.name: 无结果与局部恢复 (Scoped Empty State & Context-Preserving Recovery)
inspirations.source_prompt_zh: 搜不到时显示空状态，清空关键词后数据恢复，其他筛选条件还得保留。
inspirations.canonical_prompt: Show a contextual empty state when keyword search yields zero matches; clearing the keyword restores matching data while keeping other active filters intact.
inspirations.web_implementation: Empty state names the active query/filter and offers a 'Clear keyword' action that resets only searchQuery while preserving category and sort state.
inspirations.mobile_implementation: ContentUnavailableView.search(text:) or custom Strata empty state whose reset action clears search text without wiping selected category pills.
inspirations.token_guardrails: Empty state explains why and provides a 1-click partial recovery CTA; non-keyword filters remain preserved.
inspirations.desktop_macos_implementation: In-place `ContentUnavailableView` inside the filtered results pane naming the unmatched `searchQuery` while showing active category filter badges; provides a prominent `Button("Clear Search Keyword")` (plus `Esc` shortcut) that resets `searchQuery = ""` while keeping selected category filters and sort order intact.
inspirations.mobile_ios_implementation: Native `ContentUnavailableView` (customizing `ContentUnavailableView.search(text:)` with an explicit `actions` closure) containing a >=44pt-tall recovery button that clears only `searchQuery` with `.sensoryFeedback(.impact(weight: .light), trigger: searchQuery.isEmpty)` while preserving active category filter pills and sort state.
inspirations.native_guardrails: Empty state explicitly states which keyword produced zero results and offers a single-action partial recovery that never wipes non-keyword filters; >=4.5:1 contrast on empty-state iconography, title, description, and CTA button in Light and Dark modes; >=44x44pt CTA target on iOS and >=28x28pt on macOS.

inspirations.name: 状态联动汇总 (Live Status-to-Summary Aggregation)
inspirations.source_prompt_zh: 卡片状态一变，下方的分类数量和颜色也得跟着同步更新。
inspirations.canonical_prompt: When an item's status changes, synchronously recompute summary category counts, ratios, and semantic status colors from the same single source of truth.
inspirations.web_implementation: Derive summary badges, counts, and semantic color tokens directly from the items array rather than separate static counters.
inspirations.mobile_implementation: Computed properties on @Observable / SwiftData model collections driving summary badges and semantic tokens with .numericText() transition.
inspirations.token_guardrails: Single source of truth for item status and summary counters; semantic tokens calibrated for both Light and Dark mode.
inspirations.desktop_macos_implementation: Single `@Observable` model or SwiftData `@Query` collection where summary category counts, ratios, and semantic status colors (`Color.green`, `Color.orange`, `Color.red`, `Color.secondary`) are computed properties derived directly from item statuses; mutating a row's status immediately updates top/bottom summary cards with `.monospacedDigit()` and `.contentTransition(.numericText())`.
inspirations.mobile_ios_implementation: Reactive `@Observable` / SwiftData collection driving both individual item cards and summary status badges from a single source of truth; toggling an item's status triggers `.sensoryFeedback(.selection, trigger: statusChangeCounter)` and animates summary counters in-place via `.monospacedDigit()` and `.contentTransition(.numericText())`.
inspirations.native_guardrails: Strict single source of truth (never maintain separate manual counters that can drift from item array state); `.monospacedDigit()` on all summary numbers and percentages; semantic status colors calibrated for >=4.5:1 contrast in both Light and Dark appearances and paired with SF Symbols or text labels (never color alone); `@Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)` replaces rolling numeric transitions with instant updates.

inspirations.name: 安静杂志双栏流与右侧无框目录 (Quiet Editorial Stream & Borderless Sticky TOC)
inspirations.source_prompt_zh: 全站统一顶部毛玻璃导航栏，首页无框标题区配 1px 细线文章列表，文章详情页左侧 680px 纸张阅读卡片、右侧 240px 无框粘性目录。
inspirations.canonical_prompt: Unify all routes under a single sticky glass header (header.site-header) for quiet editorial toc reading, place the page intro directly on the L0 canvas without nested box cages, render the index feed inside a single L1 card with 1px hairline dividers, and pair a 680px prose paper card (.post-layout) with a 240px borderless sticky right-side table of contents (aside.toc, hidden below 1100px).
inspirations.web_implementation: Single token CSS chain (colors.css -> strata-theme.css -> app.css); header.site-header as the sole backdrop-filter glass layer; section.page-intro on L0 canvas; .layout two-column index with 1px hairline rows (<=3 tags/item); .post-layout (minmax(0, 680px) + 240px aside.toc) with native blockquote TL;DR, zero nested .card cages inside .prose, and natural CJK table cell wrapping.
inspirations.mobile_implementation: Single column stack on <=760px viewports (390x844 verified via Playwright setViewportSize); hide aside.toc below 1100px, collapse header navigation cleanly with >=44x44px hit targets, and wrap .prose tables in overflow-x: auto with scrollWidth <= clientWidth.
inspirations.token_guardrails: Zero hardcoded hex/RGB in app CSS; sole backdrop-filter glass on header.site-header; zero decorative heading Emojis or box-in-box callouts in .prose; CJK table cells wrap naturally while .num/time columns use tabular-nums + nowrap.
inspirations.desktop_macos_implementation: Two-column reading split (.post-layout: 680px prose card + 240px borderless sticky aside.toc) under a single site-wide sticky header.site-header.
inspirations.mobile_ios_implementation: Responsive single-column prose stream on 390x844 viewports with aside.toc hidden below 1100px and overflow-safe CJK tables.
inspirations.native_guardrails: Assert documentElement.scrollWidth <= documentElement.clientWidth at 390x844 and 1280x900 via Playwright setViewportSize; enforce <!doctype html> on line 1 (DC-006), zero decorative heading Emojis (DC-007), and natural CJK table cell wrapping (DC-008).
